entries.content: The marketplace currently offers six home service categories: HVAC (heating and air conditioning), plumbing, electrical work, home cleaning, painting, and pest control. Each service is fulfilled by verified local contractors.
The company was founded by sijo jose in 2026, with the 3 founding engineers as youwan soni, vraj somehvari and cto as tisha madame.

Booking works in three steps: 1) tell the assistant what service you need and your area pincode, 2) answer a few short questions about the job so the right professional and estimate can be prepared, 3) confirm — a work order is created and a matched contractor is notified.
All contractors on the platform go through identity verification, skill assessment, and a background check before being listed. Customer ratings after each job further affect contractor ranking.

Price estimates are generated only after the job details are collected, because they depend on the service type, scope, and your location. The assistant will show an estimate before any work order is confirmed. Exact final pricing is confirmed by the contractor on inspection.

Coverage is checked per pincode at booking time. The assistant verifies whether your specific pincode is serviceable when you provide it during the booking flow; coverage cannot be confirmed before that check runs.
Bookings can be rescheduled or cancelled free of charge up to 4 hours before the scheduled visit. Cancellations within 4 hours of the visit may incur a visit fee.
Every job comes with a 7-day service guarantee: if the same issue reappears within 7 days of the visit, a follow-up visit is arranged at no extra cost.
Payment is made after the job is completed. Supported methods are UPI, credit/debit cards, and cash. No advance payment is required for standard bookings.
Standard service hours are 8 AM to 8 PM, seven days a week. Emergency plumbing and electrical visits are available outside these hours in select areas.

For an HVAC booking the assistant needs: the type of work (installation, repair, maintenance, gas refill, or uninstallation), the unit type (split, window, central, cassette, portable), how many units, and a preferred visit date. Brand and a short issue description are optional but help.
For a cleaning booking the assistant needs: the cleaning type (deep, regular, sofa/carpet, kitchen, or bathroom), the size of your home (1BHK through villa), and a preferred date.
